items.source: Configurable bean class that exposes a specific JSR-303 Validator through its original interface as well as through the Spring Validator interface.
items.translation: 可配置的 Bean 类，通过其原始接口以及 Spring Validator 接口暴露特定的 JSR-303 Validator。

items.source: Specify a custom MessageInterpolator to use for this Validator.
items.translation: 为此验证器指定一个自定义的 MessageInterpolator 来使用。

items.source: Specify a custom TraversableResolver to use for this Validator.
items.translation: 为此 Validator 指定一个自定义的 TraversableResolver。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。

items.source: Set the ValidatorFactory to obtain the target Validator from.
items.translation: 将 ValidatorFactory 设置为获取目标 Validator 的来源。
